author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 XL CPU Deep D2 - Matrix 3072x3072 (CPU-only, Corrected v2)
abstract: Continues CPU deep triad with 3072x3072 matrix multiplication, emits op_cost_ms beacon, label "XL:Deep_D2_CPU".

original_submission.content:
import sys
import json
import time
import numpy as np
import subprocess
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

# CPU matrix multiplication (3072x3072)
start = time.time()
a = np.random.rand(3072, 3072)
b = np.random.rand(3072, 3072)
c = np.dot(a, b)
op_cost_ms = (time.time() - start) * 1000
beacon_value = float(c[0,0]) % 1000

# Emit for logs
print(json.dumps({
    "label": "CPS_v4:XL_Deep_D2_CPU mm_3072x3072",
    "beacon": beacon_value,
    "op_cost_ms": op_cost_ms
}))

# Append via helper
subprocess.call([
    'python',
    'storage/shared/meta/sas/tools/emit_cps_v4_beacon.py',
    'Zephyr V',
    'CPS_v4:XL_Deep_D2_CPU',
    str(op_cost_ms),
    'op_cost_ms',
    '7.0'
])
